description: This is the June 2012 release of the State Broadband Initiative, a national programme in which US states reported where broadband service was available. NTIA publishes it as archived data from the BTOP and SBI programmes: availability by state, county and congressional district with speed tiers, technology types, provider information and demographic context, plus a Community Anchor Institution layer. Coverage is all 50 states, the District of Columbia and five territories, for the reporting date of 30 June 2012. Files are Shapefiles for geography, CSV tables and Excel support documents, free to download by state or for the whole country, and users are asked to cite the State Broadband Initiative and the data vintage; no other licence is stated. Caveats: the data are more than a decade old, superseded by the FCC National Broadband Map and useful mainly for history. It suits capacity planning and resilience work on telecom service coverage and change over time. Related catalogue record: data-fcc-national-broadband-map.
